teksty.Fundusz Index to najstarszy projekt Koła: Index Fund is the oldest project of the INDEX Capital Markets Student Club at Krakow University of Economics. For more than 25 years we have passed on knowledge of capital markets to each new intake. We operate within Fundacja Koła Naukowego Index, the club's foundation.
teksty.Uczymy tego, czego nie ma na zajęciach:: We teach what lectures do not: where to find information, how to verify it and filter out the noise, how to value a company and defend a thesis. Members work on the tasks analysts and investors face every day. Since autumn 2026 every portfolio decision has come with an analysis, authors and a date.
teksty.Fundusz studencki na wzór tych z uczelni: A student fund modelled on those at US universities
teksty.Na wielu amerykańskich uczelniach studen: At many American universities students manage a fund themselves, often with the university's real money. They value companies, defend their ideas in front of the team and answer for the result. In Poland and across Central and Eastern Europe such projects are still rare. Index Fund brings this model to Krakow University of Economics.
teksty.Nasz portfel jest wirtualny. Analizy, gł: Our portfolio is virtual. The analyses, the vote on every company and the daily valuation work just as they do there.
teksty.Wyceniamy spółki na danych, które zmieni: We value companies using data that changes every day and work on the tasks professional analysts face. Discounted cash flow is the basis of our valuations.
teksty.Każda decyzja ma analizę, autorów i datę: Every decision comes with an analysis, authors and a date. We show the result against the S&P 500, including when it is worse.
teksty.Warsztaty, wydarzenia i konferencje z lu: Workshops, events and conferences with people who work in capital markets. We learn from them and show them our work.

teksty.Data Center to główny motor wzrostu: prz: Data Center is the main growth engine: segment revenue rose from USD 6.0bn in 2022 to USD 16.6bn in 2025. The share price is well above our DCF valuation because the market assumes faster growth than the model, which is why this is the smallest position.
teksty.Instalacje elektryczne i chłodzenie to o: Electrical and cooling systems account for about 77% of a data centre's budget, and they are EMCOR's two main segments. A shortage of contractors favours large firms, and the company holds USD 924m in cash with almost no debt.
teksty.Transco to największy gazociąg przesyłow: Transco is the largest gas transmission pipeline in the US, and Williams' infrastructure handles about a third of the country's natural gas. Cash flows are protected by take-or-pay contracts and regulated rates, while demand is rising on LNG exports and data centres.
teksty.Przejęcie Hess ze złożami w Gujanie i si: The Hess acquisition with its Guyana fields and a strong position in the Permian Basin (about 1m barrels of oil equivalent a day). Add capital discipline: USD 3bn in savings, falling debt and a quarterly dividend of USD 1.78.
teksty.Lider wyszukiwania z ok. 90% udziału w r: The search leader with about 90% market share and a single ecosystem: Search, YouTube, Android, Chrome and Google Cloud. Strong finances (net margin 32.8%, ROIC 24.9%, minimal debt), with cloud and artificial intelligence driving growth.
teksty.Stabilne przepływy z przesyłu i przetwar: Stable cash flows from gas transmission and processing. A DCF model and a comparable valuation against KMI, OKE, TRGP and DTM.
teksty.Reklama w wyszukiwarce i YouTube jako źr: Search and YouTube advertising as the cash engine, investment in artificial intelligence and Google Cloud, and an option on Waymo. A DCF model for 2026-2034.
teksty.Integracja Hess i złoża w Gujanie, przew: The Hess integration and the Guyana fields, an edge in the Permian Basin, capital discipline and shareholder payouts. A DCF model at a WACC of 8.33%.
teksty.Instalacje elektryczne i chłodzenie dla: Electrical and cooling systems for data centres, net cash and capital returns. A DCF model with three scenarios and a multiples valuation against Comfort Systems, MasTec, Quanta and IES.
teksty.Data Center i akceleratory AI jako główn: Data Center and AI accelerators as the main growth engine, improving margins and rising cash flows. A DCF model for 2026-2031 and a comparison with eight semiconductor companies.
